odia: ଯେବେ ପାଇଥାଏ ଘଇତାବୁକୁ, ସଜ ହେଉଥାଏ ବାପ ଘରକୁ
title: An assurance, then preparations
literal_meaning: When she receives encouragement or a promise from her husband, she gets ready to go to her father’s home.
explanation: The local expression ଘଇତାବୁକୁ is defined as encouragement or a promise from a husband. The saying follows that assurance with the quick, visible response of getting ready to visit her parental home. The paired endings give the movement from words to preparations a light, teasing rhythm. The source does not tell us whether the promise concerns travel, money or something else, so none of those details is treated as fixed. Read as a conversational scene, it catches the eagerness with which a welcome assurance can become action.
meaning_odia: ଘଇତାବୁକୁ ମାନେ ସ୍ୱାମୀଙ୍କଠାରୁ ମିଳିଥିବା ଉତ୍ସାହ ବା ଅଙ୍ଗୀକାର ବଚନ—ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହି ଅର୍ଥ ଦେଇଛି। ସେହି କଥା ପାଇବା ସାଙ୍ଗେ ସାଙ୍ଗେ ବାପଘରକୁ ଯିବାର ସଜବାଜ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ବୁକୁ ଓ ଘରକୁର ମିଳ ଏହି ତତ୍ପରତାକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଥଟ୍ଟାର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ। ଅଙ୍ଗୀକାରଟି ଯାତାୟାତ, ଟଙ୍କା କିମ୍ବା ଆଉ କେଉଁ ବିଷୟରେ, ଉତ୍ସ ତାହା କହେନାହିଁ। ମନକୁ ସୁହାଇଲା ଭଳି କଥାଟିଏ ମିଳିଲେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି କେମିତି ଚଟାପଟ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ, କଥାଟିକୁ ସେହି ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ିହୁଏ।
english_summary: A welcome assurance is followed by eager preparations for a visit home.
odia_summary: ମନକୁ ସୁହାଇଲା ଅଙ୍ଗୀକାର ମିଳିଲେ ବାପଘରକୁ ଯିବାର ସଜବାଜ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A woman has been hoping to visit her parents. Her husband offers to take over their shared errands that weekend, and she immediately starts packing. Her sister smiles and quotes the saying at the speed of the preparations. The offered help is an invented detail of this example, not part of the historical wording.
cultural_context: The dictionary marks the headword as a rural figurative expression. The saying presents a husband-and-wife situation; it does not establish a rule that a woman needs permission to visit her family. No particular region, marriage custom or historical incident is inferred.
